question.problem:
$$
{P}_{B\to C}=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

 

The change-of-coordinates matrix from the basis $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\}$ to the basis $C=\{{c}_{1},{c}_{2},{c}_{3}\}$ is given above. Find $[x]_{C}$ given that $x=3{b}_{1}+{b}_{2}+5{b}_{3}.$
question.worked_solution:
First, notice that since $x=3{b}_{1}+{b}_{2}+5{b}_{3},$ we have

$$
[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ 5\end{aligned}].
$$

 

Given the coordinates of $x$ relative to $B$ and the change-of-coordinates matrix from $B$ to $C,$ we find the coordinates of $x$ relative to $C$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\,x\,]_{C} & ={P}_{B\to C}[\,x\,]_{B} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ 5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}9 \\ 8 \\ 7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
